artworks.title: La Révéranse d'Arlequin
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a figure holding a mask, standing in a dynamic pose with one knee bent and the opposite arm extended. The figure has a masked face with exaggerated features and slicked-back hair, wearing a patterned costume resembling an Arlecchino character from commedia dell'arte. The figure also holds a stick or bat in its hand. The background features a detailed etching of a natural landscape with clouds and vegetation.

artworks.title: Nude Youth Leaning on a Cloud and Gazing Upward
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white on brown-red laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a male figure in a reclined position, leaning on his left arm and raising his torso upwards. He is looking towards the right side, with finely chiseled facial features, curly hair, and a muscular build. He is partially draped with cloth, bare-chested, and the background is plain.

artworks.title: The Blacksmith's Shop
artworks.artist: after Léon Cogniet after Théodore Gericault
artworks.medium: graphite and brown wash heightened with white on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horse in a workshop-like setting. The composition features a horse standing inside a stable or barn, with a wooden structure surrounding it. The horse's posture suggests that it is being prepared or maintained, possibly undergoing shoeing or a related service. To the right, a person dressed in sturdy clothing appears to be working on the horse, with one of the horse's legs elevated on a wooden support. The detailed sketch emphasizes the muscular build of the horse and the concentrated effort of the worker. This scene is drawn in a monochromatic style with intricate lines and shading, giving it a realistic touch despite its simplicity. The setting hints at an agricultural or rural context, with the presence of the horse, simple attire, and tools.

artworks.title: La Queue au Spectacle
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a black and white drawing of a crowded queue. The outdoor scene shows individuals in formal attire standing in a line behind a wooden barrier while snowflakes fall. The people are closely packed, suggesting a large crowd waiting for an event. The figures are depicted in a slightly exaggerated or caricatured style.

artworks.title: Ingrate patrie, tu n'auras pas mon oeuvre!...
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a dynamic pose, with one leg raised and the other knee bent. He is interacting with an oversized framed artwork labeled "refusé." He has long dark hair, a hand on his forehead, and appears frustrated or exerted. He wears a loose shirt and dark trousers. Papers and debris are scattered on the floor, and there are various pieces of artwork in the background. The setting resembles an artist's studio or workshop.

artworks.title: The Massacre of the Innocents
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural scene with a busy crowd. The drawing depicts a large structure with classic architectural elements like arches, columns, and decorative sculptures. The perspective highlights a detailed architectural facade stretching into the background. The scene includes many figures moving around in front of and within the architectural elements, engaged in dynamic movements. The image shows depth and detail, with groups of figures intermingled, creating a complex scene.

artworks.title: Entry of the Prince of Pfaltzbourg
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 15.5 x 24.3 cm (6 1/8 x 9 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: This drawing depicts an elaborate procession with fantastical and allegorical elements. It features a parade with ornately dressed figures marching with musical instruments, flags, and elaborate carriages. The top of the image is labeled "Entree de Monseigneur le Prince de Pfaltzbourg venant au Combat." The carriages are decorated with intricate designs and mythical creatures like a winged lion. The lower half shows a carriage disappearing into clouds, with figures in animated poses, possibly representing deities or allegorical figures. A throne-like seat on a platform amidst the clouds suggests a divine or royal presence. The style is reminiscent of the Baroque period, possibly influenced by artist Jacques Callot.

artworks.title: The Fan
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with buildings on the horizon, smoke and explosions, a swirling ornamental frame with a creature's head, people gathered around, a river with a bridge, and a monochromatic color palette with detailed line work.

artworks.title: Un Lama de Lambrunn
artworks.medium: colored chalks on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dora Donner Ide in honor of and in memory of Choy Fung
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a seated person. The individual is slightly turned towards the viewer, holding a round object and a rosary over the wrist. They have curly white hair, a green hat with a yellow and red top, and wear a dark red and burgundy traditional garment. The person's facial features include pronounced cheeks, a straight nose, and a calm expression with slightly downturned eyes. The background is plain and light-colored.

artworks.title: Façon moderne d'une Porte de Jardin (A Garden Door in the Modern Style)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is an image of an ornate garden gate. The gate is detailed with carvings and embellishments, set in a formal garden scene. Tall pillars decorated with sculptures and vases containing plants flank the gate. Above the gate, a cherubic figure holding foliage adds a whimsical touch. The background shows more of the garden landscape with a pathway leading into the distance. The drawing emphasizes the grandeur and elegance of a classical garden setting.

artworks.title: The Admission of Psyche to Olympia
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: overall (trimmed to plate mark): 19 x 50.1 cm (7 1/2 x 19 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of classical figures. The figures have various poses and interactions, with some seated and others standing. Several symbolic items are present, such as a trident and a winged staff. The figures are draped in flowing garments and some are nude. The drawing displays detailed linework and shading, creating depth and form, against a backdrop of clouds.

artworks.title: The Wedding Feast of Cupid and Psyche
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: overall (trimmed within plate mark): 18.5 x 49.7 cm (7 5/16 x 19 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a gathering scene. The image shows a large group of figures gathered around a banquet or gathering. There is a table with ornate vessels and dishes at the center, surrounded by figures engaged in conversation and activities. Some figures are depicted holding flowers or laurel wreaths. The drawing features detailed line work and shading, creating depth and movement. The composition suggests a narrative moment, possibly from mythology or ancient history.

artworks.title: Abreuvoir d'oiseaux (The Birds' Watering Place)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 33.8 x 29.6 cm (13 5/16 x 11 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The scene portrays a rustic setting with a structure in a natural landscape. The horizon is obscured by foliage and an arch. The artwork displays detailed line work capturing textures of leaves, stone, and feathers. The color scheme is primarily sepia or dark brown. Stones and an old structure are prominent, with birds present. The sky is subtly rendered with flying birds. Trees and foliage frame the composition.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on light brown wove japan paper; partial sketch of face in graphite on verso
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Hildegard Bachert in memory of Otto Kallir
artworks.description: A man with large, dark eyes glowers at us from under black brows, one of which is lowered and the other cocked in this drawn, vertical portrait. The man’s face is angled slightly to our left, but he looks out with his red lips twisted up to our right. The planes of his cheeks, lines across his forehead, nose, and thin, narrow chin are painted lightly and broadly with pale gray and pale pink to suggest light skin tone and shadows. His black hair is tousled, and the open collar of his shirt is suggested with a few lines sketched in graphite and emphasized with strokes of black paint. The artist signed and dated the drawing to the right, “EGON SHIELE 1912.”

artworks.title: A Poultry Seller
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with watercolor over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in an upright position with a wooden yoke on their shoulder, carrying two large wicker baskets. The person has distinct facial features, curly hair, and is wearing a wide-brimmed hat, long-sleeved shirt, knee-length robe or coat, knee-length breeches, stockings, and closed-strap shoes. The background features light sketching indicating a plain setting with a suggestion of a cobblestone path or courtyard.

artworks.title: A Wild Beech in Full Leaf
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white chalk on blue paper
artworks.description: The image shows a large tree as the focal point, surrounded by mountains in the background. Intricate pencil strokes capture the tree's branches and leaves in detail on textured paper. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of gray and black. Rocks and a stream are depicted in the foreground.

artworks.title: The Purification of Aeneas
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with blue wash over traces of graphite, on laid paper, squared in graphite for transfer, with later framing line in brown ink
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological scene. The composition shows several mythological figures engaged in various activities within a lush, wooded environment, near architectural structures and decorative vases. The scene centers around a group of figures, with one reclining while others attend to them. In the background, ethereal figures emerge from the clouds. The drawing uses a soft color palette and delicate line work to create a sense of depth and movement. The landscape includes rolling hills, a body of water, and distant architecture.

artworks.title: Harbor by Moonlight
artworks.medium: etching and engraving in black with scraping on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a harbor with ships in the distance, a rocky shoreline with people, and a lighthouse on the left. The scene depicts a moonlit night with clouds in the sky. The artwork is created using an etching technique with detailed lines, primarily in shades of brown and dark ink.

artworks.title: The Magdalene
artworks.medium: crayon, gouache, gold paint, and graphite over silver gelatin developed-out print mounted to board
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image depicts a person seated on a dark surface in a curled position with their knees drawn up to their chest and head bowed down, resting on their knees. The person's facial features are obscured, and their long hair falls over their face and back. The person's body is in muted tones blending with the surroundings. They appear nude and covered by a stylized fabric that merges with the environment. Small objects resembling cups or containers are near the person. The background shows a natural outdoor scene with bare trees, rolling hills, and a sky with streaks of color suggesting dawn or dusk.

artworks.title: Orvieto
artworks.medium: graphite, crayon and pen and brown ink on gray-green wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image shows a group of aged buildings against a subtly detailed sky. The skyline is blocked by the buildings, positioned in the upper part of the image. In the foreground, there is a stone wall on the left leading to a narrow path curving to the right under a small archway. A single tree stands on the right. The style is sketch-like with soft brushwork. The color palette is muted, with shades of gray, soft browns, and gentle off-whites.

artworks.title: Old Man by a River
artworks.medium: gouache and watercolor on light brown paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing outside a building on the right-hand side of the scene. A waterway winds through the composition towards the left, with trees lining the horizon. A small boat is on the bank of the waterway. Colors are warm and muted, with earth tones dominating and cool blues and grays in the sky and water. The brushstrokes are soft and painterly, creating a tranquil atmosphere.

artworks.title: Capri
artworks.medium: pastel on gray wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image shows a narrow path between two walls leading towards a distant rocky landscape. The horizon is visible near the upper third of the image against a textured sky. The brushstrokes resemble pastel work with soft, smudged lines defining the path, walls, and scenery. The walls guide the eye towards a rocky cliff in the center, with greenery on the left wall. The color palette includes soft browns, grays, blues, and muted tones to create a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Capri
artworks.medium: pastel and charcoal on dark gray wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: This image features an arched entryway framing a garden. A small statue on a pedestal is visible on the other side of the archway. The artwork shows expressive brushstrokes creating texture and depth in foliage and stone surfaces. The color palette includes deep greens, earthy browns, gray, and hints of blue and pink. Large green planters flank the entrance. A partially visible green shutter adds a pop of color. The overall lighting and colors give the scene an atmospheric quality.

artworks.title: Capri
artworks.medium: pastel and charcoal on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image shows an artwork of stone steps in a Mediterranean landscape. The steps lead upwards to the right, with a stone wall on the left. A large clay urn is on the left side, with a smaller urn further up the steps. In the background, a classical-style building with tall, narrow windows is partially visible behind a tree. The painting has delicate brushstrokes and a color palette of earthy tones and muted grays, with a vibrant hint of color at the bottom right corner.
